run_command: python solution/main.py doctor --input input && python solution/main.py build --input input --output output
notes: Exact CUDA squared-L2 top-10 index over the provided native SIFT1M debug inputs. build verifies manifest SHA-256 hashes, persists output/index/{vectors.npy,meta.json}, loads the database into GPU memory as float64, answers all 10,000 queries in memory-bounded tiles (torch.addmm, never N x N), writes output/indices.npy and output/squared_distances.npy, and records real synchronised timings plus an independent float64 CPU-oracle recall self-check in run.json. query reloads the persisted index alone (no access to input/) for new vector files; serve exposes /health and POST /search on a GPU-resident index with SIGTERM handling. All GPU paths require a real CUDA device and abort otherwise; doctor reports missing items and returns 78 when inputs or CUDA are unavailable, 0 when the job is runnable, and --help works without importing torch or loading models. No reference-large claims are made; this is the declared debug_only variant.
